description:
The Leather Training Scheme in Rajasthan was launched in 2018 as part of the efforts to promote skill development in the leather sector.

This initiative aims to enhance the employability of youth in Rajasthan by providing them with specialized training in leather craftsmanship.

The scheme is implemented by the Rajasthan Skill and Livelihoods Development Corporation (RSLDC).

The primary objective of the Leather Training Scheme is to train 10,000 youth in various aspects of leather production and craftsmanship by 2023.

The training focuses on skills such as leather goods manufacturing, leather processing, and quality control.

Participants are expected to gain hands-on experience and theoretical knowledge to prepare them for employment in the leather industry.

The scheme also aims to support the local leather industry by creating a skilled workforce that can meet the demands of the market.

The training programs are designed to be comprehensive and cover various aspects of leather production.

The benefits of the scheme include free training for participants, which is crucial for those from economically weaker sections.

Participants receive a monthly stipend of INR 2,000 during the training period to help cover their living expenses.

Upon successful completion of the training, participants are provided with placement assistance to help them secure jobs in the leather sector.

The eligibility criteria for the Leather Training Scheme include being a resident of Rajasthan.

Candidates must be between the ages of 18 and 35 years old.

There is no specific educational qualification required, making the scheme accessible to a broader audience.

However, preference is given to candidates who have completed at least the 8th grade.

To apply for the Leather Training Scheme, interested candidates must visit the official RSLDC website.

The application process involves filling out an online application form with personal details and educational qualifications.

Candidates must also upload necessary documents such as proof of residence, age proof, and educational certificates.

The application is reviewed by the RSLDC, and eligible candidates are then contacted for further steps.

The training programs under this scheme are conducted at various training centers across Rajasthan.

These centers are equipped with modern facilities and trained instructors to provide quality education.

The training duration typically lasts for three to six months depending on the specific skill set being taught.

Classes are held on weekdays, and participants are expected to attend regularly to complete the program.

The Leather Training Scheme is part of a larger initiative by the Government of India to promote skill development across various sectors.

The National Skill Development Mission launched in 2015 aims to create a skilled workforce in India.

The leather sector is a significant contributor to the Indian economy, with an estimated market size of USD 12 billion.

Rajasthan is one of the leading states in leather production, contributing significantly to the overall leather output in India.

The state government has recognized the potential of the leather industry to generate employment and boost economic growth.

The Leather Training Scheme is aligned with the state’s vision to enhance the skill set of its workforce.

The scheme also aims to empower women by encouraging their participation in the leather sector.

Women make up a significant portion of the workforce in the leather industry, and targeted training can help them secure better job opportunities.

The implementation of the scheme is monitored by the RSLDC to ensure that training standards are maintained.

Regular assessments are conducted to evaluate the effectiveness of the training programs.

Feedback from participants is collected to improve the curriculum and training methods.

The scheme also collaborates with local industries to ensure that the training provided is relevant to market needs.

This partnership helps in aligning the skills taught with the requirements of employers in the leather sector.

The Leather Training Scheme is also part of the Skill India initiative, which aims to equip millions of young Indians with skills for a better future.

The government has allocated a budget of INR 50 crores for the Leather Training Scheme for the financial year 2022-2023.

This funding supports the establishment of training centers and the development of training materials.

The scheme has seen participation from various stakeholders including NGOs and private training providers.

These collaborations enhance the reach and effectiveness of the training programs.

The success of the Leather Training Scheme is measured through placement rates and participant satisfaction.

As of October 2023, approximately 7,500 youth have been trained under the scheme.

Of these, around 60% have successfully secured employment in the leather industry.

The scheme has also contributed to the establishment of small-scale leather enterprises by trained participants.

This entrepreneurial aspect is encouraged as it helps in creating more job opportunities within the community.

The Leather Training Scheme is an essential part of Rajasthan's strategy to reduce unemployment and promote sustainable livelihoods.

By focusing on skill development in the leather sector, the state aims to create a robust ecosystem for leather production.

The scheme is expected to continue evolving to meet the changing demands of the industry.

Regular updates and improvements are made based on industry trends and participant feedback.

The government is committed to ensuring that the Leather Training Scheme remains relevant and beneficial for the youth of Rajasthan.

Overall, the Leather Training Scheme represents a significant step towards empowering youth through skill development in a vital sector of the economy.
